Name: Warrior
Description: Masters of melee combat, warriors excel in close-quarters battle with heavy armor and powerful weapons.

Name: Mage
Description: Wielders of arcane magic, mages command the elements and cast devastating spells from a distance.

Name: Rogue
Description: Stealthy assassins who strike from the shadows, rogues rely on speed and precision over brute force.

Name: Cleric
Description: Holy warriors who channel divine power to heal allies and smite enemies with righteous fury.

Name: Ranger
Description: Expert hunters and trackers, rangers are skilled with bows and have a deep connection to nature.
